Hi Alex — thanks again for the discovery today. Helpful to hear more about Nimbus Finance's plans for conversational agents across customer support and internal knowledge retrieval. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary workloads: multi-turn chat for support (avg. 1.2k tokens/session), document search + reranking for internal ops.
- Traffic pattern: bursty during business hours with heavy peaks around product launches; estimated 600 concurrent active users at peak.
- Key SLOs: 95th percentile latency target under 500ms for prompt+response, and cost sensitivity for token generation.

Next step: the team requested a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to align on throughput/latency targets and map to Dedicated pool sizing / GPU profile. Camila (cc'd), our solutions engineer, will lead the sizing. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 17 Feb, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 18 Feb, 14:00–15:00
- Thu 19 Feb, 09:00–10:00

Could you confirm which slot works best or propose alternatives? Also, if you can share preliminary throughput numbers (RPS, average tokens per request, concurrency) and any firewall/VPC requirements ahead of the call that would help us prepare. Attaching a short capacity questionnaire for the call.

Attachments: capacity-questionnaire.pdf (2 pages)

Thanks,

Hi Marissa — appreciate the recap. Wed 18 Feb 14:00–15:00 PST works great for us. Please send a calendar invite and we'll confirm internal attendees.

Preliminary numbers to help Camila prepare:
- Peak concurrent active users (we expect): ~650
- Average tokens per request: 1,150 tokens (prompt+response)
- Average requests per second during peak: ~12 RPS sustained with 30–45 RPS short bursts (10–30s)
- Target latency: 95p < 550ms; goal < 400ms for short responses
